content.stem: Sample question (not College Board content). If 2x+3=11, what is the value of x?
content.rationale: Subtracting 3 from both sides gives 2x = 8, so x = 4. Choice C is correct.

skill_desc: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units

content.stem: Sample question (not College Board content). A recipe uses 3 cups of flour for every 2 cups of sugar. How many cups of sugar are needed for 9 cups of flour?
content.rationale: Set up the proportion 3/2 = 9/x. Cross-multiplying gives 3x = 18, so x = 6.

content.body: Sample passage (not College Board content). The honeybee waggle dance communicates both the direction and the distance of a food source to other members of the hive. The angle of the dance relative to vertical corresponds to the angle of the food source relative to the sun.
content.prompt: According to the passage, the waggle dance communicates which of the following?

a.body: Only the distance to a food source

b.body: Only the direction of a food source

c.body: Both the direction and the distance of a food source

answer.rationale: The first sentence states the dance communicates both direction and distance. Choice C is correct.

skill_desc: Linear inequalities in one or two variables

content.prompt: Sample question (not College Board content, demonstrates the no-answer-key edge case). What is one possible value of x that satisfies 2x > 10?

answer.rationale: Any value greater than 5 satisfies the inequality; for example, 6.
